evidence.claim: ExpressVPN says that when you use its app it collects a limited amount of data to understand app use and facilitate marketing.
ExpressVPN says this data may include advertising identifiers only with explicit consent, used solely to understand which channels drive installs and subscriptions.
ExpressVPN says it uses several analytics services, including from third-party service providers, for user experience and analytics.

Consent can be managed or withdrawn through Privacy Settings in the app or by contacting the DPO.
